name: corhazi-lightblade-without-the-class-bonus-does-not-reveal-or-gain-critical
notes: Generated bodies gated these cards' [Class Bonus] with IsClassBonusActive($player) and NO class list, which only checks that the player controls any champion and is therefore always true: every champion got the bonus. IsClassBonusActive() now resolves the bare form against the printed class(es) of the card whose ability closure is running (GAInstallClassBonusSourceWrappers() in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php wraps the 32 affected cards' ability closures); a champion matching any of the card's classes satisfies it. Spirit of Fire is not an Assassin: the On Attack reveal does not happen.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Attack: Reveal a card from your memory at random. If a luxem element card was revealed, CARDNAME gains critical 1 until end of turn.

engineBug.summary: Class Bonus effects applied for every champion (bare IsClassBonusActive($player) is always true).
